editorial.blurb: Madame Puffs and Thai Bistro delivers authentic, beautifully executed Thai cuisine in an elegantly romantic setting with exceptional service.
editorial.insiderTip: Take advantage of the BYOB policy to bring your favorite wines and offset the upscale pricing; request seating in the garden-themed room for a particularly serene, intimate experience.
signatureDishes: Clay Pot River Prawn with Glass Noodles
